body:
I was able to make a test, but I can't quite figure out, how to fix the code :-/

So, here's the test at least:
```diff
diff --git a/test/dialect/test_sqlite.py b/test/dialect/test_sqlite.py
index d2fb752fa..bc9ac3a99 100644
--- a/test/dialect/test_sqlite.py
+++ b/test/dialect/test_sqlite.py
@@ -1795,6 +1795,15 @@ class ConstraintReflectionTest(fixtures.TestBase):
                 "conSTRAINT my_fk FOreiGN KEY (  q  , p  )   "
                 "REFERENCes   i    (  x ,   y ))"
             )
+            # Column-inline check constraint
+            conn.exec_driver_sql(
+                "CREATE TABLE column_constr (\n"
+                "value INTEGER CONSTRAINT value_ck CHECK (value > 10),\n"
+                "another VARCHAR,\n"
+                "id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n"
+                "PRIMARY KEY (id)\n"
+                ")"
+            )

             meta = MetaData()
             Table("l", meta, Column("bar", String, index=True), schema="main")
@@ -2516,6 +2525,10 @@ class ConstraintReflectionTest(fixtures.TestBase):
                 {"sqltext": "prefix NOT GLOB '*[^-. /#,]*'", "name": None},
             ],
         )
+        eq_(
+            inspector.get_check_constraints("column_constr"),
+            [{"sqltext": "(value > 10)"}]
+        )

     @testing.combinations(
         ("plain_name", "plain_name"),
```

The change was done to support newlines inside contraint text. The issue is that now the regexp includes subsequent columns inside the constraint value. I don't know if we can parse this using regexp. A parser may be needed to properly support this use case
this is 2.0.35 however I'm not sure I can do this today or even tomorrow, I've run out of time this week, if people want to chip in with the above we can try to get a third release out

@zzzeek sounds like the best option.

Maybe we can retry once we have a parser, since I was working on one for alembic in any case.
